C1124.title: Google Sues Outsider Enterprise for Abusing Gemini in Phishing Operations
C1124.summary: In June 2026, Google sued the cybercrime group Outsider Enterprise. The group operated a phishing-as-a-service platform through Telegram and abused Gemini to generate spoofed website code and scam copy. By the time of the lawsuit, the operation had created more than 9,000 fake websites and over one million malicious URLs and had sent 2.5 million scam texts to Android users during one two-week period.
